author: Zeno Ren

first_attempt.cause_detail: databricks-claude-opus-5-5 was used as a mandatory business probe; upstream returned TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (503, upstream_endpoint=southcentralus-adb-ws) due to Databricks capacity constraints

variable_isolation.method: replayed the probe at three output budgets to separate request size from time-varying capacity
variable_isolation.conclusion: intermittent upstream capacity limit, not correlated with request size

first_attempt.correction_applied: second attempt used databricks-claude-opus-5 for the release gate; 5.5 verification moved to post-release checks

model_resolution_rewritten.defect: the version regex separator class also matched the second dot in 5.5, so an explicit Opus 5.5 request silently ran on Opus 5
additional_defects: claude-haiku-5.5 resolved two tiers down to haiku-4-5
model_resolution_rewritten.wrong_assumption_removed: a contract test required claude-opus-5.1 to fall back to opus-5 as a minor revision; opus-5-1 does not exist upstream while 5-5 is a separate model
model_resolution_rewritten.approach: identify family, strip non-identity segments (8-digit date stamps and latest), normalise -_. separators, then build the name
model_resolution_rewritten.unknown_qualifier_preserved: -fast is kept rather than swallowed, which would bill a different tier than the one served

family_defaults_raised.note: newer and cheaper than the previous 4-7 / 4-6 / 4-5 defaults

pricing_added.previously_wrong: opus-5-5 substring-matched opus-5 and was billed 5/25
pricing_added.haiku_5_5_tier_limitation: officially tiered by prompt size; only the <=100K tier is encoded, >100K is 5x and under-reported, following the existing gpt-5.4/5.5 handling

effort_allowlist_exact.reason: databricks-claude-opus-5-5 contains databricks-claude-opus-5, and an unverified qualifier such as -fast must not inherit support

behaviour_changes.historical_attribution_fixed: historical_model_cost lacked a 'fable-' prefix, routing bare fable rows through the OpenAI-style inclusive-input branch

post_release_readback.source: running process in the deployed pod, not unit tests

closed_previously_unverified.why_it_could_not_close_before_release: the old gateway stripped the field before the request left, so it could not be probed from outside
closed_previously_unverified.result: accepted; claude-opus-5-5 returned x-claude-effort-forwarded: low with HTTP 200, while claude-sonnet-5-5 correctly returned x-lb-dropped-parameters

upstream_inventory_probed.note: haiku has no version 5; it goes straight from 4-5 to 5-5

tests.in_image_source_identity: main.py and effort_compat.py sha256 compared byte-for-byte against the release image; only pytest layers added, application source not mount-replaced
tests.in_image_exclusions_are_environmental: operations release package and openai/anthropic test SDKs are not in the runtime image by design, and CLAUDE.md / docs / model-capabilities.example.json are not runtime files; each exclusion was checked individually and none is a regression

corrections.retracted_claim: PR #26 stated Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 were 6/6 stable across all endpoints
corrections.status: true when measured, not true at all times

unverified_boundaries: Opus 5.5 is intermittently capacity-limited on Databricks (5/6 sampled after release); rejected requests return TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE. This is upstream capacity with no gateway-side control and must not be read as a regression of this change. The ratio is a point-in-time sample, not a stability guarantee

Fable 5.1 is region-limited (2 of 6 samples succeeded; the rest NOT_FOUND 'not available in your region'); it needs an endpoints[].models restriction, which is a configuration action not performed in this release
Haiku 5.5 pricing covers only the <=100K prompt tier; the >100K tier is 5x and under-reported
no database snapshot or isolated restore verification was performed
no independent QA review was scheduled
the three upstream rejections carried over from the previous release (120-second CANCEL, REFUSED_STREAM throttling, bare response.failed) were not touched and remain unresolved

behaviour_changes_callers_should_know.claude-opus-5.1: was silently opus-5, now resolves to opus-5-1 and gets an explicit upstream 400
behaviour_changes_callers_should_know.claude-3-opus-20240229: date stamp stripped leaves no version, so it falls to the family default (5-5)
